Hi Kimberly / team — thanks for the draft. Confirming a few items from our side:

- Procurement: procurement@cordahealth.com is running a last review cycle the week of Dec 6; approvals expected by Dec 17 if there are no major redlines. Attached is our procurement timeline for reference.
- Go-live target: Jan 15, 2027 is acceptable if procurement signs by Dec 17 and we complete integration testing in early Jan. If procurement slips, we can consider a Jan 31 fallback.
- Resources: I can commit a product owner (0.4 FTE) and an API engineer (as-needed) for the integration window. We will provide SFTP endpoints and sample payloads by Dec 6.

Please include a contingency milestone for procurement delay and a clear acceptance criterion for integration testing (e.g., 3 days of successful queued traffic and parity checks).

Thanks — Claire

Subject: Re: CordaHealth MAP & timeline — updated commitments (MAP v2)

Thanks Claire — pulling the inputs together and attached an updated MAP (v2) and a short SOW excerpt. I used the milestones Kim proposed and added acceptance criteria and owner SLAs. Summary below (also in MAP v2):

Milestone 1 — Kickoff & environment provisioning- Target: week of Nov 29- Owner(s): Sales (Kim) + Infra Ops (Redwood infra team)- Deliverables: Kicked-off project, access request submitted, VPC prep ticket opened

Milestone 2 — Data & integration readiness- Target: Dec 6 deliverables from Corda (SFTP + payloads)- Owner(s): Corda API Engineer (Claire), Solutions Eng (Neha)- Acceptance: successful nightly ingestion dry-run for 3 consecutive days in staging

Milestone 3 — Integration testing (functional & load)- Target: Dec 13–Jan 6 (adjusted for holidays)- Owner(s): Neha + Corda API Engineer- Acceptance: parity checks pass and <1% error rate under expected load for 48 hours

Milestone 4 — Training & playbook handoff- Target: Jan 3–7- Owner(s): Marissa- Deliverable: Runbook, support escalation path, CS onboarding checklist

Milestone 5 — Go-live- Target: Jan 15 (fallback Jan 31)- Owner(s): Kim + Marissa- Acceptance: 24-hour bridge with agreed SLAs and performance baseline met

Contingencies & procurement: If procurement approval slips past Dec 20, we shift the integration window by two weeks and set go-live to Jan 31. I included a procurement contingency row in MAP v2 and the SOW excerpt.

Attachments: SOW-draft-v0.3.pdf, CordaHealth_MAP_v2.xlsx (uploaded to drive)

Next steps (action items):
1) Kim to confirm kickoff meeting date & send calendar invite (suggest Nov 29, 10am PT).
2) Claire to confirm resource names and commit SFTP details by Dec 6.
3) Neha to provide test harness requirements and a list of sample payloads by Nov 20.
4) Priyom to finalize infra ticket template and provisioning checklist.

If there are no objections I will mark MAP v2 as the working document and circulate an updated version after the kickoff.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
